market_outlook.short_term: Markets face a difficult 1-3 month window: bond selloff to 2008 highs, Fed hawkish pivot, and Iran/Hormuz geopolitical risk create a risk-off tape. Equities likely choppy with sector rotation into energy and defensives. Oil/LNG volatile. Crypto under pressure. Chinese banks and dividends provide relative strength. Key variable: whether Hormuz conflict escalates or de-escalates within weeks.
market_outlook.long_term: 6-12 month outlook is cautiously constructive if geopolitical risk resolves: China turnaround signals, AI capex cycle, UK M&A wave, and biofuel-driven ag demand support selective upside. However, sustained high real yields and Fed uncertainty cap multiple expansion. Energy transition (electricity vs. oil) is a structural theme. Index concentration risk demands active diversification. Dividend growers (30+ year) and quality value outperform in this regime.
